item.title: Wrike: Director, Global GTM Strategy & Operations
item.description:
Headquarters: US - Remote

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 

About the Role:

You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. Collaborative work management is a $14B category growing at 15% a year, and the enterprise competitive set is consolidating fast. Wrike is hiring a Director of Go-To-Market Operations to lead our global GTM Operations team across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.

You will own Wrike’s revenue planning and operational architecture end-to-end driving annual planning, quota setting, territory management, and cross-functional alignment across our global revenue engine.

Reporting directly to GTM leadership, you will serve as a strategic co-pilot to executive leaders while leading a hands-on global team of 6–15 operations partners and analysts.

This is an action-oriented leadership role for an operational "athlete'' - someone equally comfortable steering C-level strategic decisions, designing enterprise sales workflows, coaching an international team across time zones, and diving deep into the details of compensation plans or GTM forecasting.

Your Impact:

  • Global Team Leadership: Build, scale, and mentor a global GTM Operations team (15 team members, including embedded business partners and visualization analysts across diverse time zones), fostering a high-performance, team-first culture.
  • Annual Planning & Execution: Lead annual planning, quota allocation, capacity modeling, and territory design across Sales, CS, and Marketing teams.
  • Retention & Growth PMO: Partner with executive leadership to program manage company-wide objectives focused on gross/net retention, bookings, and customer lifecycle optimization.
  • Executive Facilitation: Lead recurring operational cadences with executive stakeholders (Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance, Legal) to eliminate friction and accelerate deal velocity.
  • Commercial Support & Governance: Oversee non-customer-facing commercial execution, coordinating with Legal, Finance, and Deal Desk to streamline order processing and contracting workflows.

Your Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in Business Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Operations within B2B SaaS.
  • Proven People Leadership: Direct experience managing and developing global operational teams (6+ direct/indirect reports) across international time zones.
  • Core GTM Mechanics: Expertise in SaaS unit economics, quota setting, territory planning, retention/bookings metrics, and annual planning processes.
  • Execution Track Record: High proficiency operating as an executive-level partner to Sales, Marketing, and CS leadership without needing a massive administrative layer.
  • Location Preference: East Coast U.S. preferred (ability to align with global time zones and executive leadership).

Standout Qualities:

  • Core Traits: High curiosity (constantly seeking better ways to execute), unyielding commitment to follow-through, and rigorous attention to detail.
  • Sales Methodology: Familiarity with enterprise value selling frameworks (e.g., Force Management's Command of the Message, MEDDPICC, or Challenger).
  • Target Background: Experience operating in high-growth, execution-oriented B2B SaaS environments

Team Dynamics: You will partner closely with executive leadership and lead a global team of GTM business partners and data visualization specialists. Your team acts as the central nerve center connecting field execution with executive strategy.

Our Work Style: We run Wrike on Wrike. You will use our collaborative work management platform daily to run annual planning, manage operational portfolios, and track team execution. We value intellectual curiosity, data-backed decision-making, and swift cross-functional execution.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO)
  • Company 401(k) Match
  • Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Health (medical, dental & vision) Insurance (EEs + Dependents)
  • Disability (STD, LTD) & Life Insurance Plans (2x Salary, Capped)
  • Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly)
  • $500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend

Your recruitment buddy will be Aziza Talhi, Senior Recruiter.

 #LI-AT1

The range below reflects the total on-target earnings (including base salary and performance-based bonus potential) for this full-time position and applies to all U.S. locations, excluding benefits and other incentives. The final offer within this range will consider factors such as the role, seniority level, geographic location, and employment contract type. An individual’s work location, unique skills, experience, and relevant educational background will also influence the final offer. For tailored compensation details based on your preferred location, please discuss with your recruiter during the hiring process.

Total compensation pay range
$180,000—$205,000 USD

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
 
Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
 
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona 

  Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
  Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. 

Our culture and Values 

Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. 

Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

 
Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-director-global-gtm-strategy-operations

Not demos.

Real systems. Real users. Real outcomes.

A.Team exists to solve that.

No bidding.

No prospecting.

Just access to ambitious companies, difficult problems, and experienced peers.

You might be an:

- MLOps

item.title: Aquifer: Development Manager
item.skills: Ruby on Rails, SaaS, and Jira
item.description:
Headquarters: New Hampshire
URL: https://aquifer.org/

Summary

The Development Manager reports into the Chief Technology Officer and owns the engineering capacity, delivery commitments, and technical execution quality across Aquifer's development pods. Directly manages all engineers, including the pod tech leads and a technical architect, with full people-management responsibility. The Development Manager owns release reliability and the delivery/quality dimensions of engineering performance. 

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure engineering executes the cadence necessary to deliver on roadmap commitments set by the Lead Product Manager.

  • Own engineering scorecard metrics for quality and delivery.

  • Directly manage all engineers, including both pod tech leads: performance, career development, hiring, day-to-day support.

  • Provide meaningful roles and assignments for engineers through talent and capability mapping.

  • Own engineering capacity planning, translating roadmap commitments into realistic delivery plans.

  • Own release reliability and production quality across both pods.

  • Participate in engineering planning at every cadence.

  • Lead the effort with the Technical Architect to adopt AI development best practices to increase velocity and quality. 

  • Support and grow the existing Rails-based product with attention to technical sustainability and delivery cost.

  • Partner with the Lead Product Manager and both tech leads on cross-functional delivery planning.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience managing engineering teams, engineering managers, or senior individual contributors — ideally in a Ruby on Rails environment.

  • Track record of owning delivery commitments and release quality for a live SaaS product.

  • Experience managing distributed or multi-site engineering teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate the technical judgment and output of senior or staff-level engineers.

  • Comfortable setting and enforcing technical and process guardrails for AI-assisted software development.

  • Experience running structured capability assessments (e.g., evaluating a technical architect against defined deliverables) is a plus.

  • Working familiarity with Jira/Confluence.

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/aquifer-development-manager
